title: Kagamine Rin — Another Me〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (But that might be a good thing...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I wonder what Mafuyu's doing right now. Miku and the others said she's feeling a little better...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What's the matter...?
Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No...
I just wanted to take a short break here...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No.
Were you supposed to see her...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You don't have anything to do, right?
So, let's talk about stuff.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm glad you got to tell your mom how you really feel...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't remember everything I said because I was so desperate that time...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But you did your best to tell her...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Miku and KAITO were there for me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: When I felt overwhelmed with pain, I heard Miku singing... Her voice felt so warm...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (That reminds me of how Ena said she felt better after hearing me sing...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Does that mean you came here to hear Miku sing...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you for waiting, Mafuyu...
Oh, Rin's here with you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Did you already make those fixes to the demo we talked about...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. That didn't actually take very long.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ena and Mizuki should also be here soon, so I'd like it if you could all listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Mafuyu seems a little better now compared to before...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(But...
I wish I could've sung for her...)
